orders.מספר תיק בקרה: key: one order per case, kpi:cases
orders.גורם חייב: chart-category, chart-debtors, chart-biz, chart-heat, kpi:debtors, insight:category, insight:debtor — public bodies and businesses incl. sole traders are named
orders.תאריך משלוח צו: chart-yearly, chart-lag, kpi:latest, insight:latest, insight:peak, insight:lag
orders.סוג מסמך: insight:extended — extension letters mark extended orders; the base order type is 93% plain צו נגישות
orders.ישות מפוקחת: skip: free-text name of the inspected site (710 distinct); the obligated party and site type carry the comparable information
orders.ישוב: chart-city — also identifies municipalities listed by their bare city name
orders.רחוב: skip: street of the inspected site, 80% empty
orders.תת רכיב נגישות לקוי: skip: finer breakdown of the component (168 values); the component level is what aggregates across orders
orders.רכיב נגישות משנה לקוי: skip: third-level detail (614 values), too fragmented to chart
